title: Stalk maximal ideals are finitely generated on locally Noetherian schemes
statement: Let X be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth] and x a point of the scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Then the maximal ideal m_x of the local ring O_{X,x} is a finitely generated ideal.

source.place: Tag 05AR (Lemma 31.5.8), the passage from the first assertion to the locally Noetherian case: stalks of a locally Noetherian scheme are Noetherian local rings, so m_x is finitely generated
